headline: ARI @ COL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ARI 4.58 at COL 4.47, with a projected total of 9.05. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward COL: ARI moved -0.78 runs while COL moved -0.58, changing the projected margin by -0.20 runs. The projected total fell -1.35, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -5.9%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Kyle Freeland has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 3.4 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Troy Johnston, TJ Rumfield, Kyle Karros, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Brenton Doyle, Jose Fernandez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
